what: The Earth's past (the time machine's deep time)
credit: PALEOMAP PaleoAtlas and plate model, C. R. Scotese 2016 (Zenodo)
made: Painted maps of the past by a geologist, from rocks and fossils: land, sea, ice and where plants grew; today's borders, drawn on the maps, are taken out. A place's outline is moved back with the same atlas's plate model. Periods: International Chronostratigraphic Chart 2023.
